company.name: Datafold
company.shortDescription: Datafold automates data engineering with AI
company.description: Datafold is the data engineering automation platform. We combine specialized AI agents for data platform migration and optimization with the Data Knowledge Graph — a comprehensive context layer served via MCP — so data teams and their coding agents ship higher-quality data faster and reliably.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered tool that automates the translation of legacy SQL and ETL code into modern SQL dialects and transformation frameworks, ensuring data parity during migrations.
productsAndServices.name: Datafold Migration Agent

productsAndServices.description: A feature that compares data at the value level between two datasets or databases to identify discrepancies and ensure data accuracy.
productsAndServices.name: Data Diff

productsAndServices.description: A monitoring system that continuously checks data quality through scheduled data diffs, anomaly detection, schema change alerts, and data tests.
productsAndServices.name: Datafold Monitors

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven tool that analyzes SQL code changes in pull requests to enforce custom coding standards and identify potential data issues.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Code Review with AI

productsAndServices.description: A system that maps detailed data lineage at the column level across data warehouses, transformation models, and BI tools.
productsAndServices.name: Column-Level Lineage

productsAndServices.description: Capability to compare data stored in files and NoSQL databases like MongoDB to identify differences and validate data quality.
productsAndServices.name: File and NoSQL Diffing
